page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. A skill is a markdown block that any agent can link — write it once, and every agent that uses it stays in step.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a rule an agent follows — a severity rubric, a secret-leakage gate, a house convention. Write one, or import a markdown file or archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Write one yourself, or import a markdown file or archive

create.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — how you and an agent decide it applies. Write it as a directive: “Use when the diff adds a test.”
create.bodyHint: This text goes into the agent's prompt as instructions, in the order you arrange it on the agent.

file.pickHint: A .md file, or a .zip whose markdown is read and whose executable entries are ignored.
file.readError: The browser could not read that file.
file.previewHint: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
file.ignoredLabel: {count, plural, one {# entry ignored} other {# entries ignored}}
file.ignoredHint: Not read, not run — only markdown is extracted from an archive.
file.trustWarning: A skill body reaches the agent as instructions, not as quoted data. Read it before you enable it — importing someone else's skill puts someone else's instructions in your agent's prompt.
file.success: Imported “{name}”. Disabled until you vet and enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetching a user-supplied address server-side needs its own allow-list and size limits — out of scope for now. Download the file and import it instead.

community.hint: A catalog of vetted community skills is not wired up yet. Download a skill and import it from file.

preview.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Agents that link it lose it from their prompt. This cannot be undone.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source and its body reaches the agent as instructions, not as quoted data. Read it in full before enabling it — while it is disabled it contributes nothing to any prompt.
preview.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Not linked to any agent} one {Linked to # agent} other {Linked to # agents}}

config.title: Configuration
config.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive: “Use when …”.
config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version. Renaming does not — see the Versions tab.
config.tokenEstimateHint: Estimated as chars ÷ 4, same as the run trace — not a billed figure.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versionsTab.title: Versions
versionsTab.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates a new version with this body — it does not delete anything.
versionsTab.restoredToast: Restored the body from v{version} (now v{newVersion})

empty.title: No history yet
empty.body: Every body change creates a version here — nothing to show until the first edit.

comingSoon.title: Evals arrive with their own lesson
comingSoon.body: Scoring a skill's recall, precision and citation accuracy against saved cases is a separate build — this tab is a placeholder until then.

statsTab.title: Stats
statsTab.pullFrequencyHint: Runs, in the last {days} days, that had this skill enabled in the prompt — out of all runs by agents that currently link it.
statsTab.acceptRateHint: Accepted ÷ (accepted + dismissed) findings from runs that had this skill in the prompt — an ASSOCIATION, not attribution. A skill sitting in the prompt beside others gets credit for all of their findings too.
statsTab.categoryEmpty: No findings yet in this window.
